title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality and effectiveness of LLM-generated counterspeech against sexist hate speech and underlying stereotypes targeting women, using automatic metrics (METEOR, BERTScore, NLI), LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality and effectiveness of LLM-generated counterspeech against racist hate speech and underlying stereotypes targeting People of Color (POC), using automatic metrics (METEOR, BERTScore, NLI), LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality and effectiveness of LLM-generated counterspeech against xenophobic hate speech and underlying stereotypes targeting migrants, using automatic metrics (METEOR, BERTScore, NLI), LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality and effectiveness of LLM-generated counterspeech against religious hate speech and underlying stereotypes targeting Jews and Muslims, using automatic metrics (METEOR, BERTScore, NLI), LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality and effectiveness of LLM-generated counterspeech against anti-LGBTQ+ hate speech and underlying stereotypes, using automatic metrics (METEOR, BERTScore, NLI), LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluation.
